kept.title: Laneway gets salting only, no snow plowing
kept.detail: Croft Street is listed as a laneway-home location. The City's winter report says public laneways get salting only, within 24 hours after snowfall ends, and are not plowed. It also says snow can be pushed against garages and fences and block access. The data does not show whether this specific stretch of Croft Street is classed as a public laneway.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
creating the potential for snow to be pushed against garages and fences, resulting in damage or obstructed access.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow and takes about 12 hours
kept.detail: The City starts clearing sidewalks once 2 cm of snow has built up. Crews usually finish a full clearing cycle in about 12 hours, so sidewalks on the way to the stops may not be cleared yet soon after a snowfall.

cites.quote: Under current service levels, the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.
